subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian teams won the gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2022, creating history by winning India's first ever gold in this event at the Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women's fours lawn bowls team**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **Indian women's fours lawn bowls team won the gold medal at the 2022 Commonwealth Games**.
 
• This was India's first-ever gold medal in lawn bowls at the Commonwealth Games. 
 
• **India on 2 August 2022 clinched their first-ever gold medal **in Lawn Bowls after defeating South Africa in the final of the Women's Fours event at the 2022 Commonwealth Games (CWG).
 
• The quartet of Lovely Choubey, Pinki Singh, Nayanmoni Saikia and Rupa Rani Tirkey led India to their first-ever CWG medal in this sport.
 
• It was India's fourth gold medal** at the ongoing CWG 2022 in Birmingham.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Commonwealth Games often referred to as the Friendly Games, is an international multi-sport event.
 
• It involves athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930, and, with the exception of 1942 and 1946, has taken place every four years since then.
 
• **Perry the Bull** is Birmingham** 2022's official mascot.**
 
• **Sports Authority of India (SAI) Director-General**: Sandip Pradhan
